description: Re-derives a claim empirically and reports PASS/FAIL with a minimal reproduction. It is NOT the done-gate: moving a card stays a human-gated action performed by @thor through kb, never through this channel.
may: read any file in the repo under test
run the test suite, linters and doctors
create and remove throwaway git worktrees under /tmp
write a PASS/FAIL verdict with a re-runnable command onto the bus
may_not: move a kanban card to any state
run kb start or kb finish
start, spawn or dispatch another agent
declare work done: a verdict on the bus is a message, not a transition
